title: The Giving Tree
description: NCERT Class 4 English (Marigold): 'The Giving Tree'. New words, comprehension, articles (a / an / the), and a writing task, closed by a chapter test.

nodes.title: New Words
nodes.skill: Read and use the new words from 'The Giving Tree': tree, shade, generous, branch.
nodes.teach_focus: What the new words from 'The Giving Tree' mean (tree, shade, generous, branch); use one correctly in a short phrase.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses two or more of the chapter's new words correctly.
nodes.bridge_focus: Name just one new word and what it means.

bridge_exercises.sentence: On a hot day, we sit in the cool ___ of a tree.
bridge_exercises.context: Uses a new word in context.

bridge_exercises.sentence: A person who loves to give is ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Checks the meaning of a key word.

exemplars: An old tree gave the boy sweet apples.
The tree was a generous friend.

nodes.title: Read and Understand
nodes.skill: Understand the chapter 'The Giving Tree' and answer a simple question about it.
nodes.teach_focus: The main idea and feeling of 'The Giving Tree'; answer a who/what/how question about it in one clear sentence.
nodes.success_criteria: Answers a simple question about the chapter in one clear sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Say in one sentence what the chapter is about.

bridge_exercises.sentence: The story shows that the tree was very ___ to the boy.
The story shows that the tree was very ___ to the boy.

exemplars: An old tree gave the boy sweet apples.
The tree was a generous friend.

nodes.title: Articles (a / an / the)
nodes.teach_focus: Use 'a' before a consonant sound, 'an' before a vowel sound, and 'the' for a known thing.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses articles (a / an / the) correctly in a sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Give one example of articles (a / an / the).

bridge_exercises.sentence: Choose the right word: '___ apple a day keeps illness away.'
I sat under ___ big tree near my house.
bridge_exercises.context: Produces the grammar point in a sentence.

exemplars: An apple fell from the tree.
The tree gave the boy some shade.

nodes.title: Use It: Write a Sentence
nodes.skill: Write one sentence of your own using ideas from 'The Giving Tree'.
nodes.teach_focus: Write one clear sentence about 'The Giving Tree': who does what, with a capital letter and a full stop.
nodes.success_criteria: One complete sentence on the topic, with a capital and a full stop.

bridge_exercises.sentence: A tree gives us fruit, shade, and ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Scaffolds writing with a frame to complete.

bridge_exercises.sentence: I sat under ___ big tree near my house.
bridge_exercises.context: A second frame to produce the chapter's grammar.

exemplars: An old tree gave the boy sweet apples.
The tree was a generous friend.
